items.source: BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor implementation used to encapsulate common data infrastructure concerns and preprocess the ConfigurableListableBeanFactory ahead of the AOT compilation in order to prepare the Spring Data BeanDefinitions for AOT processing.
items.translation: 用于封装通用数据基础设施关注点并提前对 ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 进行预处理，以便为 AOT 编译准备 Spring Data BeanDefinitions 的 BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor 实现。

items.source: Extension to BeanRegistrationAotContribution that bases its contribution to a RegisteredBean.
items.translation: 对 BeanRegistrationAotContribution 的扩展，其贡献基于 RegisteredBean。

items.source: Builder to create AotContext instances.
items.translation: 用于创建AotContext实例的构建器。

items.source: Extension to SimpleReflectiveProcessor to register reflective hints for invoking public methods.
items.translation: 对 SimpleReflectiveProcessor 的扩展，用于注册调用公共方法的反射提示。

items.source:
Support for registering the need for reflection, resources, java serialization and proxies at runtime for Ahead of
Time compilation.
items.translation: 支持在运行时注册对反射、资源、Java 序列化及代理的需求，以用于提前编译（Ahead of Time Compilation）。

items.source: The context in which the AOT processing happens.
items.translation: AOT 处理发生的上下文。

items.source:
Configuration object that captures various AOT configuration aspects of types within the data context by offering
predefined methods to register native configuration necessary for data binding, projection proxy definitions, AOT
cglib bytecode generation and other common tasks.
items.translation: 一个配置对象，通过提供预定义方法来注册数据绑定所需的本机配置、投影代理定义、AOT cglib 字节码生成以及其他常见任务，从而捕获数据上下文中类型的各种 AOT 配置方面。
